contexts.text: They could converse together, even if one were in India, and the other in Europe.
Spirits converse with each other... SE 2952.
The converse of the interior man with the internal. Signified.
The converse of the Lord with His Father.
It was a common thing for them to introduce things as it were conversing together...
When any Spirit remembers another, he is presented, so that they can converse together.
Moses and Elias talking with Him (). When the Lord's Divine appeared in the world, none could talk with Him but those who represented the Word, for talking with the Lord is through the Word.
